proof_body:
by
  intro a α hα h
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB⟩ : ∃ A B : ℝ, a 1 = (A + B) * α ∧ a 2 = (A + 2 * B) * α ^ 2 := by
    refine ⟨a 1 / α - (a 2 - α * a 1) / α ^ 2, (a 2 - α * a 1) / α ^ 2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · field_simp
      ring
    · field_simp
      ring
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) = (A + B * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) * α ^ (m + 1) ∧ a (m + 2) = (A + B * ((m : ℝ) + 2)) * α ^ (m + 2) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      constructor
      · rw [zero_add, hA]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [zero_add, hB]
        push_cast
        ring
    | succ m ih =>
      constructor
      · rw [show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl, ih.2]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [h (m + 1) (by omega), show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl, ih.1, ih.2]
        push_cast
        ring
  refine ⟨A, B, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [(key m).1]
  push_cast
  ring
